data.heading: Cut your power bill with sunlight you already have.
data.subheading: Rooftop and ground-mount solar, battery storage and maintenance for homes, factories and campuses across South India.

data.heading: Engineering-led solar you can rely on for 25 years
data.description:
Suncrest was founded by electrical engineers who saw too many poorly built solar plants. We design every system for local weather, shading and load, and we monitor them long after installation.

From a 3 kW home rooftop to a 20 MW solar park, the same engineering standards apply — and the same team answers when you call.

items.question: How much roof area do I need?
items.answer: Roughly 100 sq ft of shade-free roof per kW of solar capacity.

items.question: Will it work during power cuts?
items.answer: Grid-tied systems switch off in outages; add a battery to keep power on.

items.question: Do you help with subsidies?
items.answer: Yes. We handle PM Surya Ghar subsidy and net-metering applications.

items.question: What maintenance is needed?
items.answer: Panel cleaning and an annual check — our O&M plans cover both.

This policy explains how we collect, use and protect the personal information you share with us through this website.

Information we collect

When you submit an enquiry we collect your name, email address, phone number and the details of your message.

We use this information only to respond to your enquiry and to provide the services you request. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on our Contact page.
